name_story.story: Nuhu can be understood through the Arabic form نُوح, whose central sense is nuhu; noah (prophet) (african form). Nuhu is the West African form of Arabic نُوح (Nūḥ), the Quranic form of the prophet Noah.

faq.a: Nuhu is associated with the Arabic form نُوح, whose core sense is nuhu; noah (prophet) (african form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Nuhu?
faq.a: Nuhu is associated with Arabic. Nuhu is the West African form of Arabic نُوح (Nūḥ), the Quranic form of the prophet Noah.
Yes — the underlying form نُوح is Arabic.
Nuhu can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Nuhu should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Nūḥ is the Quranic Arabic form of the prophet Noah and occurs in the Quran.

faq.q: What does Nuhu mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Nuhu is rendered نوح and carries the sense نوح، نبی کا نام.

faq.q: What does Nuhu mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Nuhu is rendered نوح and carries the sense نوح، نام پیامبر.
A romanized syllable approximation is nu-hu. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Nuhu?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Nuhu, nuhu. Script forms are نوح, نُوح, नूह.

faq.q: Is Nuhu a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
